# Post-Review Flow

## Contents

- Fix routing
- Invalidation
- Confirmation
- Handoff

## Fix Routing

Apply only `safe_auto` findings in a mode that permits mutation. Send
behavioral, contract, permission, migration, or product decisions to the caller
or `kb-gate`. Record advisory residual risk without manufacturing work.

## Invalidation

Any code-affecting fix invalidates the review receipt and affected deterministic
or functional proof. A documentation-only finding may preserve proof only when
it changes no executable contract.

## Confirmation

After affected proof passes, run one bounded confirmation with the same profile.
Do not add or replace profiles because the first review found issues.

## Handoff

Return finding counts, applied fixes, residual owners, proof receipt hash, and
the final review receipt fingerprint. Never commit, push, merge, or create a PR
from review modes.
